example_8_semantic_finding.title: [Semantic] Liability cap removed or unlimited — deviated from template
example_8_semantic_finding.description: Concept-level analysis: 'Liability cap removed or unlimited' violation detected. This finding is based on the legal meaning of the clause, not just wording similarity. Clause excerpt: "The Vendor's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited and shall not be capped."
example_8_semantic_finding.recommendation: Liability must be capped. Unlimited liability exposes the vendor to catastrophic financial risk.
